metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly dress shirts for your team. Wrinkle-resistant and comfortable. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom cotton poly dress shirts combine the breathability of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester. Whether you need uniform shirts for a retail team or professional attire for a trade show, this blend keeps your staff looking sharp all day. Choose from easy-care weaves or classic oxford styles, and add your logo with embroidery or screen printing for a polished, cohesive look.
